description: List callable functions by String identity in deterministic case-insensitive order. Exact-case identities are preferred. Ambiguous identities fail instead of choosing arbitrarily. Null storage returns an empty list.

outputs.name: functions
outputs.description: Returns callable String function identities in deterministic case-insensitive order, or an empty list when storage is null.

description: Find a callable function by its String identity. Matching is deterministic and case-insensitive, exact case is preferred. Ambiguous identities return FUNCTION_NAME_AMBIGUOUS. Null storage or an absent identity returns FUNCTION_NOT_FOUND with an empty function and failure result.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: String function identity to find. Matching is case-insensitive, exact case is preferred. Ambiguous identities return FUNCTION_NAME_AMBIGUOUS.

outputs.name: function
outputs.description: Returns the matched String function identity, or empty text when the function is not found.

outputs.name: found
outputs.description: Reports whether one callable String function identity was found. Null storage, missing names, and ambiguous matches return false.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Returns a successful function result for one identity, FUNCTION_NAME_AMBIGUOUS for ambiguous identities, or FUNCTION_NOT_FOUND when absent or storage is null.

description: Check whether a callable function's String identity exists. Matching is deterministic and case-insensitive, exact case is preferred, and ambiguous identities are unavailable. Null storage returns false.

inputs.name: function
inputs.description: String function identity to check. Matching is case-insensitive, exact case is preferred, and ambiguous identities are unavailable.

outputs.name: exists
outputs.description: Returns true when one callable String function identity exists. Null storage, blank identities, and ambiguous matches return false.

description: Find a String function's zero-based position. Custom lists are read without validation or mutation. Lists use the catalog when omitted or null, while explicit empty lists remain empty. Matching is case-insensitive, exact case is preferred, and ambiguous identities fail.

inputs.name: functions
inputs.description: Optional custom String function identifiers are read without validation or mutation. Omitted or null uses the catalog. An explicit empty list remains empty.

inputs.name: function
inputs.description: String function identity to locate. Matching is case-insensitive, exact case is preferred, and ambiguous identities fail.

outputs.name: index
outputs.description: Returns the zero-based position, or -1 when the String function identity is absent or ambiguous.

outputs.name: found
outputs.description: Reports whether the String function identity has one unambiguous position in the selected list.

description: Get a String function identity at a whole integer index. Omitted or null lists use the catalog. Explicit empty lists remain empty. Fractional, non-finite, or overflowing indices return FUNCTION_INDEX_INVALID. Whole out-of-range indices return FUNCTION_INDEX_OUT_OF_RANGE.

inputs.name: functions
inputs.description: Optional custom String function identifiers are read without validation or mutation. Omitted or null uses the catalog. An explicit empty list remains empty.

inputs.name: index
inputs.description: Zero-based index to read. It must be a whole finite integer within numeric range. Fractional, non-finite, or overflowing values return FUNCTION_INDEX_INVALID, while a whole out-of-range value returns FUNCTION_INDEX_OUT_OF_RANGE.

outputs.name: function
outputs.description: Returns the String function identity at the selected whole integer index, or empty text when no function is available.

outputs.name: found
outputs.description: Reports whether a whole in-range integer identifies a function. Invalid or out-of-range values return false.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Returns the selected function, FUNCTION_INDEX_INVALID for fractional, non-finite, or overflowing indices, or FUNCTION_INDEX_OUT_OF_RANGE for whole indices outside the selected list.

description: Filter callable String function identities by case-insensitive contains matching. A blank query returns the full catalog in deterministic case-insensitive order. Null storage returns an empty list.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: Text to find within String function identities. A blank query returns every callable function.

outputs.name: functions
outputs.description: Returns matching String function identities in deterministic case-insensitive order, or the full catalog for a blank query.
